import json, random, subprocess, sys, time
# layered graph with exactly 8192 paths
edges=[]; nid=1
layers=[]
for L in range(13):
    layers.append([nid, nid+1]); nid+=2
dest=nid; n=nid+1
def eid(u,v,lab): edges.append({"u":u,"v":v,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":lab})
eid(0,layers[0][0],"a"); eid(0,layers[0][1],"a")
for i in range(12):
    for u in layers[i]:
        for v in layers[i+1]:
            eid(u,v,"b")
for u in layers[-1]:
    eid(u,dest,"c")
print("n",n,"edges",len(edges))
rounds=[{"launch_us":0,"timeout_us":100000,"host_delay_us":1,"drop_host_ack":False,"drop_ping":[],"drop_ack":[]} for _ in range(48)]
doc={"version":1,"n":n,"capacity":[48]*n,"edges":edges,"rounds":rounds}
raw=json.dumps(doc).encode()
t=time.time()
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I","/work/submission/main.py"],input=raw,capture_output=True)
print("rc",p.returncode,"time %.2fs"%(time.time()-t),"outbytes",len(p.stdout))
o=json.loads(p.stdout)
print("paths",o["summary"]["topology_paths"],"classes",o["summary"]["observable_classes"], "observed", o["summary"]["observed_classes"])
print("state", o["classes"][0]["state"], "count", o["classes"][0]["candidate_count"], "witness len", len(o["classes"][0]["candidate_witnesses"]))
